what: Fiserv provides payments and banking technology. It processes card payments for merchants through Clover, runs the core banking systems many American banks rely on, and handles card issuing and bill payment.
customers: Merchants of all sizes, banks and credit unions, and corporate and government clients.
money: payment processing and the Clover point-of-sale platform
core banking systems, card issuing and digital banking
moat: Core banking systems that a bank cannot replace without rebuilding its operations, and a merchant base that runs its tills and payments through Clover.
risks: It reported a large loss in the latest period after goodwill charges
Debt of about $27 billion against almost no cash
Growth guidance was cut sharply and management changed
Clover's growth rate has slowed, and it was the main reason investors held the shares
opportunities: Revenue grew about 4% last year with a 27% operating margin
Core banking contracts are long and extremely sticky
New management is resetting expectations and cutting costs
watch: Clover revenue growth and organic revenue growth excluding acquisitions.
